description: CamScanner for ChatGPT helps you bridge the gap between physical documents and digital intelligence seamlessly. Upload, scan, and identify text from any image; extract high-precision data with OCR for ChatGPT to analyze, summarize, or translate; and capture handwritten or printed content in a single click. You can also turn complex photos into structured text for instant AI processing. Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone who wants fast, reliable image-to-text solutions without opening another app.

defaultPrompt: Please help me extract the content from the image
